intro.text: The sea of glass beads in Shadesmar that mirrors central and eastern Roshar.

description.text: Like all seas in Shadesmar, it is made of small beads, not water. There is no wind, yet the beads roil and clack constantly.
Its peninsulas match rivers in the Physical Realm, and its islands match lakes; the land is like dark glass. Channels are cut through some peninsulas, especially those of the Deathbend River.
Non-sapient spren live in the sea, and plants such as fernlike growths and mushroom-like trees grow along some shores.

items.text: The honorspren once tried to conquer all of Shadesmar, which left them a poor reputation among other spren.
At the start of the True Desolation, the Fused took over many of the sea's cities, ruling lightly.

Shallan, Kaladin, Adolin and their companions, trapped in Shadesmar after Kholinar, crossed the sea by ship to Celebrant, fled aboard the honorspren ship Honor's Path, and travelled on to Thaylen City.
